instruction: Use Pymatgen to download the perovskite SrTiO3 structure (mp-5229) from Materials Project. Apply SpacegroupAnalyzer to perform symmetry analysis and extract the conventional standard structure to ensure lattice orthogonality. Export the processed structure as a CIF file and save it to the desktop. Then open the CIF file in VESTA, switch the display style to 'Ball and Stick' model, and save the file as 'SrTiO3_structure.vesta' to the desktop.

result.description: The VESTA file contains the conventional standard cell of perovskite SrTiO3 (space group Pm-3m, cubic). It should be a valid VESTA format file containing Sr, Ti, and O atoms. The display style should be set to Ball and Stick model.
